narrative.overview: This is an established visual world extracted from the user-supplied Stitch screenshots and their HTML, not a fresh theme selection. The screenshots govern composition and material; paired HTML supplies supporting dimensions, font identities and colors. The exported nested design document is secondary where it contradicts a screenshot.
keyCharacteristics: blue-black canvas; restrained frosted panels; icy high-contrast text; cyan operational emphasis; compact mobile single-column screens. This is an Operate interface, not a promotional dashboard.

rules.name: The Evidence Rule
rules.body: Reference statistics and recovery colors are not evidence of the owner's achievements or physiology. Keep their visual slots, but populate them only with real records or honest empty states.

dos: Do preserve the supplied six screen structures, control placement and visual hierarchy.
Do provide keyboard access, readable contrast, reduced-motion support, safe-area spacing and non-blur fallback.
Do use local fonts and bundled SVG icons consistent with the outlined reference icons.
Do keep missing media and network failure separate from workout logging.
donts: Don't copy broken avatars, clipped titles, overlapping inputs, disabled browser zoom or placeholder charts as intentional design.
Don't add GPT, accounts, cloud sync, estimated recovery guarantees or an unrelated desktop redesign.
Don't package private reference screenshots/exports into the public app build.
